proof:
classical
intro N inst a
change (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : ZMod N => a i ≠ 0)).card = 0 ↔ a = 0
constructor
· intro h
  have hempty := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp h
  funext i
  change a i = 0
  by_contra hi
  have hmem : i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun j : ZMod N => a j ≠ 0) :=
    Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, hi⟩
  simp [hempty] at hmem
· rintro rfl
  simp
